about: Vanilla Elden Ring weapon categories each Kratos weapon borrows its moveset from. Resolved by scanning EquipParamWeapon at boot (no hard-coded row ids).

rows.name: Axe
rows.why: One-handed chopping combos with a shield in the off hand: the closest native moveset to Kratos' axe-and-shield loop.

rows.name: Whip
rows.why: Long lashing arcs with reach: the native moveset nearest to chained blades. Shield is stowed while the Blades are out, as in Ragnarök.

rows.name: Spear
rows.why: Thrusts and sweeps with a shield; Draupnir's throw/summon is layered by the DLL.

rows.name: Medium Shield
rows.why: Block, guard counter and a parry window; used as the Guardian Shield carrier.
